name: Fixed rig around a turntable

original_specification.name: Fixed rig around a turntable
original_specification.description: A proposed lighting arrangement for multiple views of one product.
original_specification.geometry: Object rotates around explicit Z axis; rig does not automatically follow
original_specification.contribution_policy: Sources and comparison exposure remain fixed
original_specification.authoring_method: Original procedural rig specification; author numeric emitters and physical cards, then calibrate in the fixed reference scene. No third-party assets included.
validation: Reflections change coherently as the object rotates

scale_policy: Scale light positions/sizes once to an explicitly selected subject; never scale the subject.
